spec.title: Availability
spec.description: Right now this is in active development stage, so it's entirely possible that I stopped the strategy to experiment. So don't get concerned if availability is 0 for some time! :)

spec.query:
SELECT last("pnl")
FROM "acct_lvl_daily_pnl"
WHERE ("level"::tag = '3' AND "label"::tag =~ /^DEFI--.*/)
  AND $timeFilter
GROUP BY time($__interval), "label"::tag
FILL(previous)

SELECT cumulative_sum(sum("expected_pnl_post_fill")) AS "Total Tx", cumulative_sum(sum("skew_adjusted_pnl_post_fill")) AS "Skew Adjusted Tx", cumulative_sum(sum("expected_pnl_pre_fill")) AS "Expected pnl" FROM "defi_cefi_arbitrage_post_fill_trade" WHERE ("stage" =~ /^$stage$/ AND "mode" =~ /^$mode$/ AND "dex"::tag =~ /^$dex$/ AND "pool"::tag =~ /^$pool$/ AND "network"::tag =~ /^$network$/ AND "is_defi_trigger"::tag =~ /^$is_defi_trigger$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(0)

SELECT cumulative_sum(sum("expected_pnl_post_fill")) FROM "defi_cefi_arbitrage_v0_post_trade" WHERE ("stage" =~ /^$stage$/ AND "mode" =~ /^$mode$/ AND "network" =~ /^$network$/ AND "dex" =~ /^$dex$/ AND "pool" =~ /^$pool$/ AND "contract_error" = '0') AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

SELECT cumulative_sum(sum("expected_pnl_post_fill")) FROM "defi_cefi_arbitrage_v0_post_trade" WHERE ("stage" =~ /^$stage$/ AND "mode" =~ /^$mode$/ AND "network" =~ /^$network$/ AND "dex" =~ /^$dex$/ AND "pool" =~ /^$pool$/ AND "contract_error" = '0') AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

SELECT cumulative_sum(sum("selini_paid_bid_usd")) FROM "defi_cefi_arbitrage_v0_auction" WHERE ("stage" =~ /^$stage$/ AND "mode" =~ /^$mode$/ AND "network" =~ /^$network$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(0)

spec.query: SELECT max("main_runtime_threads") AS "Runtime Threads", max("runtime_tasks") AS "Runtime Tasks", max("pinned_threads") AS "Pinned Threads" FROM "defi_cefi_arbitrage_process_state" WHERE ("network"::tag =~ /^$network$/ AND "mode"::tag =~ /^$mode$/ AND "stage"::tag =~ /^$stage$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "stage"::tag, "mode"::tag fill(null)

SELECT "round", "express_lane_controller", "winning_bid_usd", "paid_price_usd", "selini_bid_usd", "selini_paid_bid_usd", "selini_computed_bid_usd", "reserve_price_usd", "stage", "mode", "round"  *60000+1741687071000 AS "round_start" FROM "defi_cefi_arbitrage_v0_auction" WHERE ("mode"::tag =~ /^$mode$/ AND "stage"::tag =~ /^$stage$/ AND "network"::tag =~ /^$network$/) AND $timeFilter ORDER BY time DESC

SELECT count("alive") AS "Count", 100 * (1- sum("contract_error_fld")/count("alive")) AS "Hit Rate (accurate for Arbitrum only)", sum("expected_pnl_post_fill") AS "PnL", sum("skew_adjusted_pnl_post_fill") AS "Skew-Adjuted PnL",  sum("expected_pnl_post_fill") - sum("expected_pnl_pre_fill") AS "Slippage",  sum("fill_size_usd") AS "Volume", 10000 * sum("expected_pnl_post_fill") / sum("fill_size_usd") AS "PPM"
FROM "defi_cefi_arbitrage_post_fill_trade"
WHERE ("network"::tag =~ /^$network$/ AND "mode"::tag =~ /^$mode$/ AND "dex"::tag =~ /^$dex$/ AND "pool"::tag =~ /^$pool$/ AND "stage"::tag =~ /^$stage$/ AND "is_defi_trigger"::tag =~ /^$is_defi_trigger$/)
AND $timeFilter
GROUP BY "network"::tag, "stage"::tag, "mode"::tag, "dex"::tag, "pool"::tag
fill(null)

spec.title: DeFi digs (bps)
spec.description: These are the digs from max to min lot size

spec.query:
SELECT 
  mean("price_difference")
FROM (
  SELECT 
    ("defi_sell_price_pre_fill_min" - "defi_sell_price_pre_fill_max") * 10000 / "defi_sell_price_pre_fill_min"  AS "price_difference" 
  FROM 
    "defi_cefi_arbitrage_eval" 
  WHERE 
    "stage" =~ /^$stage$/ 
    AND "mode" =~ /^$mode$/ 
    AND "network" =~ /^$network$/ 
    AND "dex" =~ /^$dex$/ 
    AND "pool" =~ /^$pool$/ 
    AND $timeFilter 
) 
GROUP BY 
  time(30m) 
fill(null)

WHERE ("network"::tag =~ /^$network$/ AND "mode"::tag =~ /^$mode$/ AND "stage"::tag =~ /^$stage$/)

spec.query:
SELECT
    SUM("pnl_no_hedge") AS "total_pnl_no_hedge",
    SUM("size_usd") AS "total_size_usd"
FROM "default_defi_retention"."defi_cefi_arbitrage_competitor_trade"
WHERE (
  "network"::tag =~ /^$network$/ AND 
  "dex"::tag =~ /^$dex$/ AND 
  "pool"::tag =~ /^$pool$/
) 
AND $timeFilter
GROUP BY
    "dex",
    "pool",
    "taker"

SELECT 
  "time",
  "tx_hash",
  "dex", 
  "pool", 
 "is_cefi_trigger",
 "is_defi_trigger",
 "total_broadcast_latency_us" / 1000 as "total_broadcast_latency ms",
 "tick_to_trades_latency_us" / 1000 as "tick to trade ms",
 "post_processing_tick_latency_us" / 1000 as "post-processing to trade ms",
 "all_requests_failed"
FROM defi_cefi_arbitrage_executor
WHERE (
  "network"::tag =~ /^$network$/ AND 
  "mode"::tag =~ /^$mode$/ AND 
  "dex"::tag =~ /^$dex$/ AND 
  "pool"::tag =~ /^$pool$/ AND 
  "stage"::tag =~ /^$stage$/ AND
  "is_defi_trigger"::tag =~ /^$is_defi_trigger$/
) 
AND $timeFilter 
ORDER BY time DESC 
LIMIT 30000

SELECT cumulative_sum(sum("pnl_no_hedge_10000ms")) FROM "markout_df" WHERE ("chain"::tag =~ /^$network$/ AND "dex"::tag =~ /^$dex$/ AND "pool"::tag =~ /^$pool$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($interval), "taker"::field fill(0)

SELECT cumulative_sum(sum("pnl_no_hedge_60000ms")) FROM "markout_df" WHERE ("chain"::tag =~ /^$network$/ AND "dex"::tag =~ /^$dex$/ AND "pool"::tag =~ /^$pool$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($interval), "taker"::field fill(0)

SELECT

  "taker",

  "cancelled",
  "cancelled_freely",
  "simulation_failed",

  "expected_pnl_post_fill" AS "exp post fill pnl", 
  "expected_pnl_post_fill" - "expected_pnl_pre_fill" AS "pnl slippage", 
  "fh_receive_to_strategy_latency_ns" / 1000000 as "Tao to DeFi ms",
  "pre_fill_unix_ns" / 1000000 AS "pre_fill_unix_ms", 
  "post_fill_unix_ns" / 1000000 AS "post_fill_unix_ms",
 "post_fill_unix_ns" / 1000000 - "pre_fill_unix_ns" / 1000000 AS "delay_ms",
   "post_fill_flashblock_unix_ns" / 1000000 - "pre_fill_unix_ns" / 1000000 AS "optimistic_rcv_delay_ms",
  "time_since_latest_block_pre_fill_us" / 1000 as "ntwrk block millis", 
  "my_timestamp_minus_block_timestamp_us" / 1000 as "prtcl block millis",
  "estimated_gas", "actual_gas",
  "estimated_bribe_fee_usd", 
  "expected_spread_bps" AS "exp spread bps", 
  "realized_spread_bps" AS "rlzd spread bps",

  "sell_skew_bps_pre_fill" - "sell_skew_bps_no_preemptive_pre_fill" as "sell pre-emptive widening bps", "buy_skew_bps_no_preemptive_pre_fill" - "buy_skew_bps_pre_fill" as "buy pre-emptive widening bps",
  "sell_skew_bps_pre_fill" as "sell skew",
  "buy_skew_bps_pre_fill" as "buy skew",

WHERE (
  "network"::tag =~ /^$network$/ AND 
  "mode"::tag =~ /^$mode$/ AND 
  "dex"::tag =~ /^$dex$/ AND 
  "pool"::tag =~ /^$pool$/ AND 
  "stage"::tag =~ /^$stage$/ AND
  "is_rfq_trigger"::tag = 'true'

spec.title: Tick to Trade (micros)
spec.description: Includes DeFi Trigger latencies as well which, at the moment, make network calls.

spec.query:
SELECT
  ("defi_buy_price_pre_fill" - "defi_actual_fill_price") * 10000 / "defi_buy_price_pre_fill" as "defi buy slip bps"

FROM "default_defi_retention"."defi_cefi_arbitrage_pre_fill_trade"

WHERE 
 "is_buy"::tag =~ /^true$/ AND
  "network"::tag =~ /^$network$/ AND 
  "mode"::tag =~ /^$mode$/ AND 
  "dex"::tag =~ /^$dex$/ AND
  "dex"::tag != 'jupiterrfq' AND
  "pool"::tag =~ /^$pool$/ AND
  "stage"::tag =~ /^$stage$/ AND
  "is_defi_trigger"::tag =~ /^$is_defi_trigger$/ AND
  $timeFilter

SELECT
  ("defi_actual_fill_price" - "defi_sell_price_pre_fill") * 10000 / "defi_sell_price_pre_fill" as "defi sell slip bps"

FROM "default_defi_retention"."defi_cefi_arbitrage_pre_fill_trade"

WHERE 
 "is_buy"::tag =~ /^false$/ AND
  "network"::tag =~ /^$network$/ AND 
  "mode"::tag =~ /^$mode$/ AND
